name: Pangolin
description: Pangolin at its core is a self-hosted tunneled reverse proxy with identity and access management, designed to securely expose private resources through encrypted WireGuard tunnels running in user space. Think self hosted Cloudflare tunnels.

notes.text: If the LXC is created Privileged, the script will automatically set up USB passthrough.
Run Compose V2 by replacing the hyphen (-) with a space, using `docker compose`, instead of `docker-compose`.
Options to Install Portainer and/or Docker Compose V2
